== Biography ==
George was born in 1818 at Lanarkshire, Scotland to William Glasgow and Janet Thomson.<ref>"Scotland, Select Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950"; Ancestry.com [database on-line]; George Glasgow, b. 8 Jun 1818, bap. 14 Jun 1818 at Crawford, Lanark; f=William Glasgow m=Janet Thomson.</ref>


== Research Notes ==
=== Crawford family connection — 31 October 2026 ===

George Glasgow-638 is already described in his held and live biography as the Crawford child of William Glasgow and Janet Thomson, but neither parent profile is attached. The inspected Scotland baptism index names that exact couple for George, born 8 June 1818 and baptised 14 June at Crawford. An exact-parent search returned thirteen Crawford entries spanning 1802–1828, including Isabel in 1808 and an older George in 1810. The inspected monumental-inscription transcript identifies William Glasgow-2715, gamekeeper to the Earl of Hopetoun, his wife Janet Thomson, their daughter Isabel (died 1881 aged 73), and an older George who died in July 1816. The 1841 census transcript places gamekeeper William with Janet and Isabella at Hass, Crawford; the 1851 transcript gives widower William, 72, born Crawford, with daughter Isabella and younger children. This combination supports the gamekeeper as the 1818 child’s father, with reuse of the deceased child’s name. The proposed attachment to the later Leicester adult is assessed at 88% subjective confidence, including the unresolved childhood-to-adult identification.<ref name="Crawford1818">FamilySearch, [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XTLF-1QX Scotland Births and Baptisms, George Glasgow], birth 8 June/baptism 14 June 1818, Crawford, William Glasgow and Janet Thomson, source detail 2:15KCJHH. Original unavailable in inspected view; [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_685665034&tab=this Findmypast R_685665034] reproduces the same index.</ref><ref name="CrawfordMemorial">Scottish Genealogy Society, Scotland Monumental Inscriptions, [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=PRS%2FSCOTLAND%2FMI%2FADD%2F5%2F00557896&tab=this William Glasgow, Crawford], Findmypast PRS/SCOTLAND/MI/ADD/5/00557896. Provider transcript inspected 31 October 2026; gravestone image uninspected.</ref><ref name="CrawfordCensus">Findmypast, [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=GBC/1841/0017061572&expand=true 1841 census GBC/1841/0017061572] and [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=GBC/1851/0019486912&expand=true 1851 census GBC/1851/0019486912], Hass, Crawford, William Glasgow gamekeeper and household. Provider transcripts inspected 31 October 2026; originals uninspected.</ref>

The baptism and census originals and gravestone image have not been inspected; these are provider index/transcript readings. FamilySearch and Findmypast reproduce the same underlying baptism index and are not independent evidence. The later Leicester adult’s exact birthday may derive from the baptism, so it is not counted as independent confirmation. His inspected 1843 GRO marriage index locates a Leicester entry with Mary Ann Norton among the same-page spouse possibilities, but gives no father or father’s occupation. The original marriage is the decisive next test. The memorial’s older George, died 1816 aged 7, cannot be the 1818 child; its reported age differs by about a year from the 1810 baptism and remains unresolved. Some sibling index birth fields contain malformed years and the 1806 John dates conflict; none is silently corrected. William Glasgow-1533, the circa-1795 Glasgow-born weaver with a Janet Thomson wife, remains a distinct comparison rather than being excluded merely for missing fields: the gamekeeper’s 1841/1851 Crawford household, older age, trade, wife and Isabel chronology provide the positive match. No exact vital replacement, mother attachment, profile merger or upstream father is inferred.<ref name="Leicester1843">England and Wales marriages 1837–2005, George Glasgow, Leicester, Q3 1843, volume 15, page 158, [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=BMD%2FM%2F1843%2F3%2FAZ%2F000191%2F137&tab=this Findmypast GRO index]. Mary Ann Norton is a same-page spouse possibility. This is not a marriage certificate or a father clause.</ref>

Proposed family amendment: add [[Glasgow-2715|William Glasgow]], Crawford gamekeeper, as father of [[Glasgow-638|George Glasgow]], probable at 88%. No live WikiTree save has been made.
